state.description: Construct a new 500kV line from Farley (APC) to Tazewell substation, approximately 120 miles long. Construct a 5 breaker 500kV ring bus to loop in the Blacksmith - Talbot 500kV line, terminate the new Farley - Tazewell 500kV and Talbot #2 - Tazewell 500kV lines. Install a 500/230kV auto transformer to connect to the existing 230kV switchyard.
